narr: Stationary thunderstorms developed southwest of Chugwater along Chugwater Creek leading to high flows and flash flooding during the afternoon of the 6th.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding at a ranch near Chugwater Creek carrying away numerous large logs downstream.
lsr: Heavy rain caused flash flooding of dump on Jordan Ranch with numerous large logs washed out and carried downstream. Chugwater Creek remains high at 7/300PM.
